metadata.description: Near-infrared, red and blue observations highlight surface differences. Gray grid marks missing color coverage; detail varies across the map.
metadata.title: Enhanced color combines MVIC near-infrared, red and blue bands with panchromatic detail. Colors are not natural color or measured albedo. Missing coverage remains a gray grid.

science.label: Elevation
science.description: New Horizons terrain model · shaded relief
science.title: Color encodes elevation relative to a 606 km reference sphere. Fixed northwest relief lighting reveals terrain slopes; gray grid marks missing measurements.

science.label: Water ice
science.description: Water ice absorbs strongly near 2.0 µm across Charon’s observed terrain. Colors show the depth of that absorption, which also depends on ice grain size. Grid: no usable spectrum.
science.title: Water-ice absorption

science.label: Ammonia
science.description: A weak 2.2 µm absorption is associated with ammonia-bearing material, including ejecta around Organa crater. Colors show infrared contrast averaged over roughly 12 km; fine variations include instrument noise. Grid: no usable spectrum.
science.title: Ammonia-related absorption

source.label: JPL Planetary Satellite Mean Orbital Parameters
JPL Planetary Satellite Mean Orbital Parameters
Derived from JPL GM 106.1 km³/s² and radius 606.0 km; the table's density cell repeats Pluto's 1.853

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: New Horizons observed terrain; southern darkness remains unavailable. Native detail varies across the map. The source already applies Lunar-Lambert photometric correction; local photographed terrain shadows remain.

controls.label: False color
controls.notes: Enhanced color combines MVIC near-infrared, red and blue bands, sharpened with panchromatic detail. It is not natural color or quantitative albedo. Gray grid marks missing color coverage; detail varies across the map.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Measured topography relative to a 606 km sphere. Gray grid marks missing elevation. Stereo/shape-from-shading product; 300 m grid spacing is not uniform effective resolution.

controls.label: Bond albedo
controls.notes: New Horizons photometric model estimating the fraction of sunlight reflected by Charon. Derived from LORRI brightness and scattering assumptions, not a direct bolometric measurement. Gray grid marks missing source cells and uncovered southern latitudes. Colors span 0.1–0.5; values beyond those limits use endpoint colors.
